title: Netflix to give Greta Gerwig’s ‘Narnia’ wide theatrical release, marking a first
byline: Netflix on Friday said it would put filmmaker Greta Gerwig’s “Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew” movie in wide theatrical release next year, where it will play exclusively for more than 45 days - a first for the streaming service.

title: Trump says he’s dissatisfied with Iranian proposal as rift with allies deepens
byline: US President Donald Trump said on Friday he was not satisfied with the latest Iranian proposal for talks on the Iran war, while Iran’s foreign minister said Tehran was ready for diplomacy if the United States changes its approach.

title: US Treasury warns shippers not to pay Hormuz tolls, even in form of charity
byline: Any shipper paying tolls to Iran for passage through the Strait of Hormuz, including charitable donations to organizations such as the Iranian Red Crescent Society, is at risk of punitive sanctions, the U.S. Treasury warned on Friday.

title: Showers expected in several provinces after 1pm today
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, Uva and Eastern provinces and in Polonnaruwa, Galle and Matara districts after 1.00 pm, the Department of Meteorology stated.

title: At least 11 dead in western Mexico after bus careens off highway
byline: A holiday Labor Day weekend turned tragic on Friday as at least 11 people died and 31 others were injured when a tourist bus crashed in Mexico’s western state of Nayarit.

title: Vesak ‘Dansal’ registration to begin Monday
byline: Public Health Inspectors Union (PHIU) says registration of Vesak ‘Dansal’ will commence from Monday (04) ahead of the upcoming Vesak celebrations.

title: AI actors and writers will be ineligible for Oscars
byline: Academy Awards organizers issued new rules on Friday to clarify that acting and writing must be performed by humans and not artificial intelligence to be eligible for the movie industry’s highest honors.

title: US to cut troop levels in Germany by 5,000 amid Trump spat with Merz
byline: The US Defence Department plans to withdraw 5,000 troops from Germany, amid a spat between President Donald Trump and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz over the war with Iran.

title: Trump says US Navy acting ‘like pirates’ to carry out naval blockade of Iranian ports
byline: President Donald Trump said on Friday the U.S. Navy was acting “like pirates” in carrying out Washington’s naval blockade of Iranian ports during the U.S. and Israel’s war against Iran.

title: Sri Lanka’s tourist arrivals surpass 850,000 so far this year
byline: The Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority (SLTDA) stated that the number of tourist arrivals in Sri Lanka so far this year has crossed the 850,000 mark.

title: Teenager drowns while swimming in Katupila Lake
byline: A 16-year-old schoolboy has drowned while swimming in Katupila Lake within the Sewanagala Police Division.

title: Spirit Airlines faces potential shutdown as bailout negotiations stall
byline: Spirit Airlines is reportedly preparing to shut down indefinitely after filing for bankruptcy last summer, as recent government bailout negotiations appear to have failed.

title: One killed in head-on motorcycle collision in Horowpathana
byline: One person has died following a head-on collision between two motorcycles at the 134th kilometre post along the Puttalam-Trincomalee road in Horowpathana.

title: Final rites of FinMin official suspended over $2.5M cyber fraud to be held today
byline: The final rites of the Assistant Director of the External Resources Department of the Ministry of Finance Ranga Nishantha Rajapaksa, who was found dead while under suspension in connection with the alleged misappropriation of USD 2.5 million linked to a cyber heist, are scheduled to be performed this evening (02).

title: Suspect arrested with foreign-made pistol in Pannala
byline: A 38-year-old suspect has been arrested in the Hunuwila area of Pannala for the possession of a foreign-made pistol.

title: Over 25,000 dengue cases reported so far in 2026
byline: The National Dengue Control Unit (NDCU) says that a total of 25,082 dengue cases have been reported across Sri Lanka so far in 2026.

title: 22 monks arrested with narcotics at BIA to be produced before court today
byline: A group of 22 Buddhist monks recently arrested over the smuggling of “Kush” cannabis and “Hashish” from Thailand are scheduled to be produced before the Negombo Magistrate’s Court again today (02).

title: India’s historic rise a gateway for Sri Lanka’s future collaboration and progress – Sajith
byline: Opposition Leader Sajith Premadasa says that the relationship between Sri Lanka and India must never be viewed through the prism of competition, but rather embraced as a tremendous opportunity for mutual prosperity.

title: Advisory issued for severe lightning
byline: An ‘Amber’ advisory has been issued by the Department of Meteorology for severe lightning in the Northern, North-Central, Central, Sabaragamuwa, Eastern and in Uva provinces.

title: Special traffic plan announced for Maldivian President’s visit
byline: Sri Lanka Police have taken steps to implement a special traffic plan in view of the upcoming official visit of Maldivian President Mohamed Muizzu to Sri Lanka.

title: ‘Feels good when India thrives’: MP Harsha de Silva says Sri Lanka ‘part of Indian story’
byline: Sri Lankan economist and politician Harsha de Silva on Saturday lauded India’s growth over the years, saying that it feels good when India is doing well.

title: 22 monks arrested with narcotics at BIA remanded
byline: The group of 22 Buddhist monks recently arrested over the smuggling of “Kush” cannabis and “Hashish” from Thailand have been remanded until May 12 by the Negombo Magistrate’s Court.

title: Sri Lanka’s Brief Garden featured in New York Times Style Magazine
byline: Brief Garden in Beruwala has been featured in The New York Times Style Magazine’s latest feature titled “Nine Artists on the Gardens They’ll Never Forget.”

title: Shiral calls for ‘psychological autopsy’ into death of Finance Ministry official
byline: Former Western Provincial Councillor and Attorney-at-Law Shiral Lakthilake says that a psychological autopsy should be conducted on the death of the Assistant Director of the Finance Ministry’s Foreign Resources Department, who was suspended in connection with the alleged misappropriation of USD 2.5 million linked to a suspected cyber theft.

title: Iranian proposal rejected by Trump would open strait before nuclear talks: Iran official
byline: An Iranian proposal so far rejected by U.S. President Donald Trump would open shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and end the U.S. blockade of Iran while leaving talks on Iran’s nuclear programme for later, a senior Iranian official said on Saturday.

title: 37 Chinese nationals arrested on suspicion of online scams remanded
byline: Thirty-seven Chinese nationals, including a woman, have been arrested and remanded on suspicion of engaging in online financial scams in Sri Lanka.

title: Thirteen killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, health ministry says
byline: At least 13 people, including four women and a child, have been killed in Israeli air strikes on southern Lebanon, the Lebanese health ministry said.

title: Fuel prices increased
byline: The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (Ceypetco) has announced a revision of fuel prices, effective from midnight today (02).

title: ‘Colombo is a port for India’: Ceylon Chamber chief
byline: In a significant affirmation of deepening India-Sri Lanka economic ties, Krishan Balendra, Chairman of the Ceylon Chamber of Commerce and John Keells Group, described Colombo as “a port for India” during his address at the ZEE Media WION Global Innovation & Leadership Summit held in Colombo on Saturday.
